versions.subject: Big Update
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'PowerShell.EXE'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'Get-ADUser '
        - ' -Filter \*'
condition: all of selection
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine="*Get-ADUser *" CommandLine="* -Filter \**"
